rationale: The exploration-heavy fourth batch found a substantially better incumbent and lifted the GP maximum to essentially the same level. At the campaign midpoint, this supports a measured increase in exploitation while retaining most of the batch for uncertainty and coverage.
expected_outcome: The exploit queue should yield compounds near the 10.254 incumbent and may improve it; the exploratory 22 should add at least 15 scaffolds while keeping median uncertainty on a downward trend.
